description: This file defines data models for a To-Do List application, including classes for Token, UserPublic, and Todo, each with serialization and deserialization methods.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Represents an authentication token with methods for JSON serialization.

methods.name: Token
methods.description: Constructor for creating a Token instance, requires accessToken and optional tokenType.

methods.name: Token.fromJson
methods.description: Factory method to create a Token instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts Token object to a JSON map.

classes.name: UserPublic
classes.description: Represents a public user profile with methods for JSON serialization.

methods.name: UserPublic
methods.description: Constructor for creating a UserPublic instance.

methods.name: UserPublic.fromJson
methods.description: Factory method to create a UserPublic instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts UserPublic object to a JSON map.

classes.name: Todo
classes.description: Represents a to-do item with various attributes and methods for JSON serialization, copying, and updating.

methods.name: Todo
methods.description: Constructor for creating a Todo instance.

methods.name: Todo.fromJson
methods.description: Factory method to create a Todo instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts Todo object to a JSON map.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Returns a copy of the Todo with specified fields replaced.
